name: run_checks
description: Run a shell command in your worktree (a project check such as `cargo test`, `pnpm test` or `just ci`) and get its exit code and the tail of its output. Only exit code 0 counts as passing. Every failed run uses up one of your limited check cycles.

command.description: Shell command, run with `sh -lc` in the worktree

cwd.description: Optional sub-directory of the worktree to run in (relative, inside the worktree)
